# telnyx_ai_assistant_clone (Action)

Copies an AI assistant into a new assistant. Terraform does not manage the copy; import it as a telnyx_ai_assistant to manage it.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assistant_id` (String) The assistant id.
